label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to new java.net.URL(target) at L25, which is used to create HttpURLConnection. Validation checks are insufficient: !target.startsWith('https://') allows both http AND https (should be 'https://' prefix requirement), and InetAddress checks only cover loopback/site-local, not all internal addresses. Resolved sink value at L25 is attacker-controlled target parameter.

evidence.note: User input param -> target -> URL(target).openConnection() at L25; validation insufficient to prevent SSRF
